# STRK20 Tip Jar

> A worked example of adding Starknet Privacy (STRK20) to an app that already exists. It starts as an ordinary public tip jar deployed on Starknet mainnet and gains a private tipping path beside the public one, over the Starknet Wallet API, with zero changes to the deployed contract. Every file below is raw Markdown or source, fetchable as-is.

Read TUTORIAL.md first if you want to understand the integration; read AGENTS.md first if you are changing the code. The two tags `v1-public` and `v2-private` bracket the whole integration, so any claim about its size is checkable with `git diff`.

## Start here

- [TUTORIAL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/TUTORIAL.md): The walkthrough end to end - the ordinary app, the problem shown on-chain, privacy added with the agent skill, then how to design the UX around it.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/README.md): What the repo is, the live mainnet addresses, quick start, and what to design for.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/AGENTS.md): Orientation for changing the code - layout, commands, and the conventions that have tests behind them.

## The integration

- [app/src/lib/strk20.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/app/src/lib/strk20.ts): The whole privacy surface in ~70 lines - the STRK20 action shapes plus capability detection, pure and unit-tested. Start here to see what STRK20 costs in code.
- [app/src/lib/strk20.test.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/app/src/lib/strk20.test.ts): The tests that pin the two decisions worth pinning: a private tip is a lone transfer and never bundles a deposit, and capability detection touches no private state.
- [app/src/hooks/useTipJar.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/app/src/hooks/useTipJar.ts): All Starknet wiring - connect, shield, private swap, private tip, public tip, and the maturity countdown.
- [app/src/config.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/app/src/config.ts): Every on-chain address and network setting, and why server-side keys must not carry a VITE_ prefix.
- [app/api/paymaster.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/app/api/paymaster.ts): Server-side proxy for AVNU's paymaster, so the API key never reaches the browser.

## Contracts

- [contracts/src/tipjar.cairo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/contracts/src/tipjar.cairo): The public tip jar. Non-custodial, one entrypoint, and unchanged by the privacy work.
- [docs/ANONYMIZER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/docs/ANONYMIZER.md): A reference privacy_invoke anonymizer, and when you would actually need one. Not audited, not deployed - AVNU ships private swaps, so this app needs none.

## Records

- [docs/STRK20_INTEGRATION.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/docs/STRK20_INTEGRATION.md): The integration log, phase by phase, including the mainnet evidence and the design that was built one way and shipped another.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): How the pieces fit and what STRK20 changes.
- [docs/DEPLOYMENT.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): The live mainnet deployment, how to deploy your own jar, and what running on Sepolia would take.
- [STRK20_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starkience/strk20-tipjar-example/main/STRK20_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md): The plan the STRK20 agent skill generated, kept with its corrections visible rather than rewritten.
